payload.prompt: Photorealistic product-style reference for 3D modelling: the single subject centred with generous margin on a seamless plain mid-grey studio backdrop, soft even key light with a gentle rim light, sharp focus, true materials (lacquer, chrome, leather, rubber, rust, scale, steel), no text, no logos, no people, only a soft contact shadow.
